required_trace_semantics: paired successful API operations with contract-specific success semantics
concrete named arguments preserving input/output roles
one process lifetime and symbolic state
ordered non-overlapping stages, bounded time and call gaps
handle invalidation and same-thread scope when specified
missing fields are insufficient telemetry, never negative behavior evidence

rules.name: query bound registry variant for Credentials in Registry
rules.description: Reads an explicit password value from a PuTTY session key; credential use is not inferred.

rules.name: query bound registry variant for Backup Software Discovery
rules.description: Queries installation/version information on an exact backup software configuration key.

rules.name: encrypt and replace a bound user document
rules.description: Binds captured document bytes to successful encryption input/output and to replacement writes on the same file. Authorization, original sample identity, and impact beyond this file remain unproven.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: archive collected document bytes using a custom XOR transform
rules.description: Requires a nonzero constant-byte XOR relationship across at least 32 captured bytes read from a document and written to a separate archive handle. It does not infer exfiltration or adversary intent.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: truncate a bound user document to zero length
rules.description: Observes a successful zero-offset truncation of a user-document handle. Its previous contents and unauthorized destructive intent require qualification.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: zero a physical-drive initial sector
rules.description: Requires actual captured sector bytes written at offset zero on a bound physical drive. A boot-code replacement is a pre-OS modification candidate; a zero-sector overwrite is a destruction candidate. Boot execution, malicious code, full-disk wiping, and device effects are not qualified.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: zero a physical-drive initial sector
rules.description: Requires actual captured sector bytes written at offset zero on a bound physical drive. qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: replace a physical-drive boot sector
rules.description: Requires actual captured sector bytes written at offset zero on a bound physical drive. qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.description: Requires actual captured sector bytes written at offset zero on a bound physical drive. qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: read content from a classified removable volume
rules.description: Binds a successful nonempty read to the exact drive reported DRIVE_REMOVABLE; it does not assume every non-system drive is removable.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: copy collected document bytes onto removable media
rules.description: Requires captured user-document bytes to be written to the same classified removable volume. Removal of the medium and unauthorized disclosure remain unproven.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: copy collected document bytes to a USB-classified volume
rules.description: Derives BusTypeUsb from a captured STORAGE_DEVICE_DESCRIPTOR response for the bound volume; DRIVE_REMOVABLE alone never establishes USB. Requires document-byte equality at the media write.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: replicate the current image onto a classified removable drive
rules.description: Binds the current executable image to the source of a removable-drive copy. It does not infer autorun or actual infection of a second host.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: relocate the current executable image
rules.description: Requires a successful relocation of the actual current executable path; original malware identity and evasion intent remain unproven.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: copy a system utility under a different executable name
rules.description: Observes copying a known system-utility path and launching the destination under a different basename. Signature/publisher authenticity and malicious intent still require qualification.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: write inside a previously observed antivirus path exclusion
rules.description: Binds a write to a boundary-checked path read from an existing Defender exclusion setting; adding an exclusion is a separate behavior. Effective policy, reparse-point resolution, and payload identity require qualification.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: store a parsed executable payload in a registry binary value
rules.description: Requires a complete structurally parsed PE payload stored as REG_BINARY on the bound key. It observes fileless payload storage, not its subsequent execution or maliciousness.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: give a user-path service a Windows service display identity
rules.description: Binds a system-looking display name to a service image configured under a user directory. It does not infer publisher trust, service execution, or malicious intent.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: observe a file Authenticode digest mismatch
rules.description: Observes TRUST_E_BAD_DIGEST for the exact Authenticode file verification action. An untrusted chain or an arbitrary failed API does not satisfy this predicate. Malicious masquerading intent remains unproven.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: modify a previously trusted host binary and observe a digest mismatch
rules.description: Requires a trusted host binary, a bound modification, and a subsequent bad-digest result on the same path. Actual object continuity, legitimate update exclusion, sample identity, and malicious intent require qualification.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: request elevation through a user-controlled auto-elevation command
rules.description: A direct UAC-bypass implementation predicate for the elevation-control parent technique. Actual elevated token, child payload execution, patched-system behavior, and malicious intent remain unproven.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: authenticate and resolve a built-in account SID
rules.description: Requires successful logon and a bound TokenUser SID with account-domain prefix and built-in Administrator/Guest RID. A username or successful authentication alone does not establish a default account. Unauthorized use is not inferred.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: plant and resolve a system-named DLL through a modified DLL directory
rules.description: Requires parsed DLL bytes, search-directory modification, an unqualified system-DLL name, and actual resolved-module path equality. Publisher identity, expected dependency, loader causality, and malicious code execution remain unqualified.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: resolve an unqualified executable inside a modified PATH directory
rules.description: Requires actual child-image resolution to the planted executable after PATH modification and an unqualified launch request. Expected trusted helper, working-directory alternatives, causal search-order influence, and malicious intent still require qualification.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: execute a command through a bound DDE conversation
rules.description: A direct DDE command-execution predicate for the IPC parent technique. No automatic parent roll-up or malicious-intent claim.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: receive an HTTP command and request its execution
rules.description: Binds the HTTP body to the actual command-line argument of a successful launch in the same process/state. A generic HTTP request never satisfies the rule; actor identity, child execution, and intent remain unqualified.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: receive HTTP commands on a nondefault high port
rules.description: Requires a high-port HTTP command channel with observed command-to-launch equality; a connection to an unusual port alone is insufficient.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: receive and launch a command through an FTP file
rules.description: Requires FTP service selection, the bound remote-file handle, and exact received-command/launch equality. FTP API names or ordinary downloads do not establish the predicate.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: receive and launch a DNS TXT command
rules.description: Binds an actual TXT response's contents to a successful command launch; an arbitrary DNS lookup does not qualify.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: receive and launch an MQTT message payload
rules.description: Uses the Paho native client's actual connected handle and received payload length/content. Pub/sub capability alone does not establish C2.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: retrieve and launch a POP3 message body
rules.description: Requires a complete POP3 retrieval response and execution of its exact message body. Ordinary mail API references never count.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: decode and launch a base64 command from the bound channel
rules.description: Binds received C2 text, verified Base64 decoder input/output, and the actual command-line argument. Encoding unrelated file data cannot satisfy the predicate.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: decode and launch a base64 command from the bound channel
rules.description: Binds received C2 text, verified Base64 decoder input/output, and the actual command-line argument. Encoding unrelated file data cannot satisfy the predicate.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: recover and launch a transformed command from the bound channel
rules.description: Requires a concrete algebraic relation between received bytes and the launched command: a nonzero fixed XOR across at least 16 bytes, or a discarded uniform prefix of at least 32 bytes. Intent and the sample's decoder implementation remain unqualified.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: decrypt and launch a command from an algorithm-bound channel
rules.description: Binds network ciphertext to successful CSP decryption and the resulting command launch. Symmetric/RSA variants require the actual key's KP_ALGID response; unrelated crypto calls or supplied algorithm labels do not count.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: decrypt and launch a command from an algorithm-bound channel
rules.description: Binds network ciphertext to successful CSP decryption and the resulting command launch. Symmetric/RSA variants require the actual key's KP_ALGID response; unrelated crypto calls or supplied algorithm labels do not count.

rules.name: send collected document bytes over the established command channel
rules.description: Establishes the HTTP channel's command role through received-command execution, then binds local document bytes to a request on that same connection. It does not infer exfiltration from arbitrary network sends.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: send collected bytes over FTP distinct from the observed HTTP command channel
rules.description: Requires an established HTTP command channel, a separate FTP output channel, and exact collected-data/transfer equality. Encrypted variants bind the CSP key algorithm and encrypted bytes. Host aliases, protocol confidentiality, actual peer identity, unauthorized disclosure, and completed transfer require independent qualification.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: receive commands and upload collected data through the same web service
rules.description: Requires both observed directions: a Gist-hosted command passed to a launch and a local document placed in an outgoing Gist JSON request. It never infers bidirectional C2 from a generic service connection.

rules.name: resolve the next command endpoint through a web-service dead drop

rules.name: read a removable-medium command and request its execution
rules.description: Binds a received command on a classified removable volume to the actual command-line argument. An arbitrary removable-file access does not establish a command channel.

rules.name: recover and launch a pixel-LSB command from a received BMP
rules.description: Requires a structurally valid 24-bit BMP, the explicit length-prefixed pixel-LSB decoder variant, and exact equality with the actual launched command. Merely receiving an image does not qualify.

rules.name: send collected bytes over Bluetooth alongside an observed HTTP command channel

rules.description: Within the bounded session, three cache-bypassing A queries for one hostname must return distinct low-TTL addresses, and each exact address must supply a command passed to a launch. DNS rotation alone is insufficient; infrastructure ownership, CDN distinctions, long-term flux operation, and malicious intent remain unqualified.

rules.name: replace a remote native-x86 TLS callback-table pointer
rules.description: Binds a remote PID, native x86 PEB image pointer, actual PE TLS RVA, TLS descriptor, pointer replacement, and a target-thread request. Offset constants alone do not qualify. Actual payload/table validity, callback control transfer, sample provenance, and malicious intent remain unqualified.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects

rules.name: replace the bound remote process command-line buffer
rules.description: Follows native-x86 PEB.ProcessParameters to the actual UNICODE_STRING command-line buffer, reads its old bytes, then observes a same-length replacement on that exact process/address. A generic remote write is insufficient. External process-creation baseline, display effect, and malicious concealment remain unqualified.
qualification_required: target identity and independently checked effects
